Pull Request Revisions

RevisionDescription
r13
Removed GitHub workflow test fileDeleted .github/workflows/test-integration-policyv2.yaml workflow file for integration testing with various test scenarios
r12
Updated auto-approval route test tagsReplaced hardcoded user email with generic "tag:approve" in route test auto-approvers configuration
r11
Enhanced Test Infrastructure and PoliciesComprehensive changes to integration tests, including: - Enhanced test scenarios with more authentication and routing test cases - Improved Tailscale node and scenario management - Added utility functions for policy testing - Refactored node route handling and tag management - Extended debug and error reporting capabilities
r10
Modify extra login args appending methodChanged WithExtraLoginArgs to append arguments instead of direct assignment in TailscaleInContainer struct
r9
Added auto route approval in registrationImplemented auto route approval handling during node registration process by calling policy.AutoApproveRoutes before saving node information
8 more revisions
r8
Multiple integration test and code improvementsComprehensive changes including refactoring integration tests, adding utility methods, improving route handling, and enhancing test scenarios with more robust network and node management
r7
Refactored scenario network handlingMoved network-related variables and methods from global scope to Scenario struct, improving encapsulation and test flexibility
r6
Updated integration test infrastructure methodsModified integration test helper methods including client ID retrieval, node finding, and route testing with more robust error handling
r5
Test now covers route advertisement scenariosExpanded integration test to include route advertisement scenarios by adding parameter to test matrix for routes advertised during or after initial connection
r4
Whitespace adjustment in workflow filesMinor whitespace formatting changes in two GitHub Actions workflow files, specifically around comments and spacing
r3
Multiple refactoring and testing improvementsChanges include route handling in policy, node tag management, integration test enhancements, and added utility methods for debugging. Specifically updated slices usage, added string representations, and improved node route count assertion in tests.
r2
Refactored route and node handling codeMultiple improvements to policy, route, and node handling, including adding slices utility functions, fixing error handling, and enhancing debug information across policy and node management components
r1
Refactored route auto-approval logicEnhanced route auto-approval mechanisms with improved logging, tag handling, and policy management across multiple files. Added more robust tracing and debugging capabilities for route and tag approval processes.
